description: This file is a JavaScript module that provides an API client for interacting with a backend server. It includes functions for creating jobs, uploading files and templates, starting processes, fetching status, results, and downloading reports. It reads configuration from environment variables and implements fallbacks for offline or misconfigured scenarios.

methods.name: getApiBase()
methods.description: Returns the API base URL from environment variable REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, stripping trailing slashes.

methods.name: safeFetch(url, options = {})
methods.description: Performs a fetch request with error handling, returning the response or throwing an error with a console warning if failed.

methods.name: createJob()
methods.description: Creates a new backend processing job; returns a mock jobId if backend URL is not configured.

methods.name: uploadFiles(jobId, files)
methods.description: Uploads multiple files to a specified job; returns success info or mock success if backend URL is absent.

methods.name: uploadTemplate(jobId, file)
methods.description: Uploads an Excel template file for mapping for a specified job, with fallback for missing backend URL.

methods.name: startProcess(jobId)
methods.description: Initiates the processing workflow for a given job.

methods.name: getStatus(jobId)
methods.description: Retrieves the current processing status, including phase and progress, with mock data fallback.

methods.name: getResults(jobId)
methods.description: Fetches the final results including entities, mappings, and validation issues.

methods.name: downloadReport(jobId)
methods.description: Downloads the resulting report as a Blob object; throws an error if backend URL is not configured.
